referees.quote: It is an interesting research, but I would like my question below to be answered well before I can make a recommendation.

the claim of observing superconductivity on the 1T surface—and its purported competition with local “paramagnetic puddles”—is not fully convincing. Additional clarification and justification are needed to support these conclusions.

note: All recommendations come from Version 0, and none of the three referees used a standard recommendation term, so all are inferred. R1 withheld a recommendation pending answers to nine substantive questions, including a quantitative comparison of the Kondo and Brinkman-Rice scenarios; this is read as major revision. R2 judged the work in principle suitable and asked mainly for justification of the theoretical model and more detail on methods; this is read as minor revision. R3 asked for substantial new data and analysis (vortex maps, temperature and field evolution of the gap with fits, 4Hb slab DFT) to support a key claim; this is read as major revision. The file shows no sign of a transfer from another journal, and no referee co-signed another's report.
